name: adra-unified-work-evidence-recovery-passport
description: ADRA Recovery Passport with GPT-5.6 Agents SDK reasoning, persistent adaptive memory, proactive notifications, permission-aware task execution, visible UI activity traces, ML/deep-learning advisories and deterministic financial controls.

scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check src/agents.js && node --check src/math-engine.js && node --check src/intelligence-engine.js && node --check src/engine-runtime.js && node --check src/knowledge-base.js && node --check src/memory-store.js && node --check src/record-store.js && node --check src/persistent-session.js && node --check src/operational-store.js && node --check src/learning-store.js && node --check src/mts-store.js && node --check src/training-data-store.js && node --check src/live-data-store.js && node --check src/control-center-store.js && node --check src/supabase.js && node --check public/workbook-engine.js && node --check public/app.js && node --check src/system-brain.js && node --check src/brain-store.js && node --check src/agent-activity-store.js && node --check src/auth-session-store.js && node --check src/supabase-state.js && node --check src/supabase-storage.js && node --check app.js && node --check netlify/functions/api.mjs
scripts.netlify-build: npm run check && npm run verify-netlify-entry && npm run verify-netlify-deps
scripts.verify-netlify-deps: node -e "for (const p of ['dotenv','serverless-http','@netlify/aws-lambda-compat','express','helmet','@supabase/supabase-js','@openai/agents','zod']) require.resolve(p); console.log('All Netlify runtime dependencies resolved')"
scripts.verify-netlify-entry: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('netlify/functions/api.mjs','utf8');for(const x of [\"from 'serverless-http'\",\"from '@netlify/aws-lambda-compat'\",\"from '../../server.js'\",'export default withLambda'])if(!s.includes(x))throw new Error('Netlify ESM entry is missing required adapter/import: '+x);console.log('Netlify modern ESM entry verified')"
